text: The monsters that are indistinguishable from\ngoblins nor orcs are breaking the holy gems\nhaphazardly...
Thanks for helping us.\nWe were surrounded by the monsters and there was\nnothing we could do...
Yes, we were creating holy gems here but...\nThe monsters suddenly appeared and...
Our magic attacks were ineffective against them.\nAll we could do was escape.
That's too bad. But now you are safe!\nBy the way, is Naiata here?
Naiata should still be in the workshop ahead.
She was absorbed in something while we were\ntrying to escape...
So, we need to go there...\nYou guys should evacuate right now.\nWatch your steps.
